blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items.
Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a “System One Model,” for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency.
Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models.
Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality–latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains.
These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recommender systems commonly adopt multi-stage architectures in which an efficient retrieval model first identifies a manageable set of candidate items and a more expressive ranking model subsequently determines their final ordering Covington et al. (2016) .
This separation allows the ranking stage to leverage richer representations and more computationally intensive models that are typically infeasible during large-scale retrieval.
Sequential recommendation models such as SASRec capture users’ evolving preferences from interaction histories Kang and McAuley (2018) , while feature-interaction models such as DCNv2 provide efficient mechanisms for learning complex relationships among ranking features Wang et al. (2021) .
More recently, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as another approach to reranking because they can directly reason over textual representations of user histories and candidate items Hou et al. (2024) ; Luo et al. (2025) .

这种分离使排名阶段能够利用更丰富的表示和在计算上更密集的模型,这些模型在大规模检索过程中通常不可行.

最近,大语言模式(LLMs)也成为重新排位的另一种方法,因为它们可以直接解释用户历史的文字表述和候选项目Hou等人(2024年);Roo等人(2025年)。

blocks.en:
Despite their flexibility, LLM-based reranking introduces an important tension between recommendation quality and inference efficiency .
Existing approaches formulate ranking in pointwise, pairwise, or listwise forms Luo et al. (2025) ; Chao et al. (2024) .
A pointwise LLM reranker independently estimates the relevance of each candidate, enabling fine-grained item-level judgments but requiring computation to grow with the number of candidates.
Listwise reranking instead evaluates multiple candidates jointly, reducing the number of model invocations but requiring the model to reason over increasingly long and complex candidate lists.
Prior work has noted both the computational inefficiency of pointwise and pairwise LLM ranking and the challenges faced by listwise approaches in accurately modeling ordering relationships Chao et al. (2024) ; Qin et al. (2024) .
These tradeoffs are particularly consequential in practical recommendation systems, where rerankers may need to process tens or hundreds of candidates under latency constraints.

blocks.en:
The recent introduction of Jev suggests a different approach.
TypeSafe AI describes Jev as its first “System One Model,” designed for fast, structured decision making rather than free-form text generation Almeida (2026) .
Instead of generating free-form text, Jev accepts contextual state and focused questions and returns typed probabilistic decisions.
This interface maps naturally onto recommendation reranking: a user’s interaction history defines the decision state, candidate items define the available alternatives, and the resulting probabilities directly serve as ranking scores.
This raises a broader question: can a decision-oriented model offer a distinct quality–latency tradeoff compared with recommendation-specific models and LLM-based rerankers?

In this work, we conduct a controlled empirical investigation of Jev for personalized recommendation reranking.
Rather than evaluating end-to-end retrieval, we construct hard candidate sets in which the held-out next item is paired with behaviorally plausible negatives retrieved by SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018) .
This design isolates reranking ability from retrieval failure and ensures that all methods operate on the same users and candidate items.
We vary the candidate-set size from K = 20 K=20 to K = 200 K=200 and evaluate recommendation quality using NDCG@10, Hit Rate@10, MRR, and observed serving latency.

We repeat the evaluation across Amazon Movies and TV, Video Games, and Books Hou et al. (2026) to examine whether the observed patterns persist across domains.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Sequential and Text-Aware Recommendation
blocks.zh: 2.1 顺序和文字了解建议

blocks.en:
Sequential recommendation models user interaction histories to predict future preferences.
Transformer-based approaches such as SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018) and BERT4Rec Sun et al. (2019) capture dependencies among historical interactions and have become widely used sequential recommendation architectures.
More recent text-aware methods incorporate semantic item information beyond learned item IDs.
UniSRec Hou et al. (2022) learns transferable item and sequence representations from textual descriptions, while RecFormer Li et al. (2023) represents items and interaction sequences through language representations.
These methods demonstrate the value of combining behavioral and semantic information for recommendation.
Our study focuses specifically on the reranking stage and uses SASRec and DCNv2 Wang et al. (2021) as representative recommendation-specific baselines.
blocks.zh:
序列推荐模式为用户交互历史,以预测未来的偏好.
基于变形器的方法,如SASRec Kang和McAuley(2018年)和BERT4Rec Sun等人. (2019)捕捉历史互动中的依赖性,并成为广泛使用的顺序推荐架构.
较新的文本认识方法将语义学项目信息纳入到学到的项目ID之外.
UniSRec 软件 许等. (2022)从文字描述中学习了可转移的项目和序列表示,而RecFormer Li et al. (2023)通过语言表示代表项目和交互序列.
这些方法显示了将行为信息和语义信息结合起来供推荐的价值.
我们的研究特别侧重于重排阶段,并使用SASRec和DCNv2 Wang等人. (2021)作为具有代表性的建议具体基准。

blocks.en: 2.2 Large Language Models for Recommendation Reranking
blocks.zh: 2.2 建议重新排序的大语文模式

blocks.en:
Large language models have increasingly been applied to recommendation because they can reason directly over textual representations of users and items Wu et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. (2025) ; Lyu et al. (2024) .
Particularly relevant to our setting, Hou et al. (2024) formulate recommendation as ranking a retrieved candidate set conditioned on a user’s interaction history, demonstrating the potential of LLMs for zero-shot recommendation ranking.
Subsequent work has explored pointwise, pairwise, and listwise ranking formulations, including instruction-tuned approaches such as RecRanker Luo et al. (2025) .
These formulations exhibit different computational characteristics: pointwise ranking evaluates candidates individually, whereas listwise ranking considers multiple candidates jointly.
Our study compares pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers under identical candidate sets and examines how their recommendation quality and observed latency change as candidate-set size increases.
We treat these models as representative LLM-based reranking configurations rather than as an exhaustive characterization of LLM reranking.

与我们的环境特别相关 许等. (2024) 拟订建议,作为以用户互动历史为条件的检索候选人的排名,表明LLMS在零镜头建议排名方面的潜力。
随后的工作探索了指向,对称,列表排列的配方,包括RecRanker Luo等人(2025年)等指令调制方法.
这些提法表现出不同的计算特征:按点排列会逐个评价候选人,而按列表排列会共同考虑多个候选人.
我们的研究是按点比较的,按清单比较的 在相同的候选人组合下重新排行榜,并审查他们的推荐质量和观察到的延迟变化,因为候选人设定的人数增加。
我们将这些模型视为具有代表性的LLM重排配置,而不是LLM重排的详尽描述.

blocks.en: 2.3 Structured Decision Making
blocks.zh: 2.3 结构化决策

blocks.en:
Recent work has explored the use of large pretrained models for structured decision making rather than only language generation.
Decision Transformer Chen et al. (2021) formulates reinforcement learning as conditional sequence modeling.
Gato Reed et al. (2022) similarly applies autoregressive sequence modeling to a multimodal, multitask policy that can emit both text and action tokens, while RT-2 Zitkovich et al. (2023) co-fine-tunes pretrained vision-language models to produce robotic actions represented as tokens.
Jev Almeida (2026) is particularly relevant to recommendation reranking, where a user history can provide decision context and retrieved items define a finite set of alternatives.
Our work empirically investigates how this decision-oriented formulation behaves relative to recommendation-specific models and the evaluated LLM rerankers, with particular attention to recommendation quality, candidate-set scaling, and observed serving latency.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作探索了使用经过预先培训的大型模型进行结构化决策,而不仅仅是语言生成。
决定变换器 陈等. (2021)将强化学习发展为有条件的序列建模.
加图 李德等编. (2022年)同样将自递序列模型应用到一种能够同时发出文本和动作符的多式联运,多任务政策中,而RT-2 Zitkovich等人. (2023)共同fine-tuns 预训视觉语言模型 制作机器人动作作为符号代表.
Jev Almeida(2026年)与建议重新排序特别相关,因为用户历史可以提供决策背景,检索到的项目可以定义一组有限的替代品。
我们的工作从经验上调查了这种面向决定的表述方式相对于具体建议模式和经评估的LLM重新排序者的表现方式,特别注意建议质量、候选人设定比例以及观察到的服务延迟。

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

blocks.en:
We study controlled candidate reranking in a two-stage recommendation setting.
Our objective is not to introduce a new recommendation architecture, but to investigate how decision-oriented, LLM-based, and recommendation-specific models compare when reranking the same behaviorally plausible candidate sets.

Candidate construction can substantially affect the difficulty of reranking.
Randomly sampled negatives can yield artificially easy ranking problems because many sampled items may be semantically unrelated to the user’s interests. We therefore focus on a controlled hard candidate setting in which negative items are drawn from highly ranked retrieval results.

blocks.en: 3.5 Study Objective
blocks.zh: 3.5 学习目标

blocks.en:
Our objective is to characterize how the evaluated recommendation-specific,
Qwen-based, and decision-oriented approaches behave under the same controlled
candidate reranking setting.
We examine this question along three dimensions: effectiveness , measured by the quality of the resulting candidate ranking; efficiency , measured by observed serving latency; and scalability , measured by how both quality and latency change as the candidate-set size increases from K = 20 K=20 to K = 200 K=200 . Together, these dimensions characterize the quality–latency tradeoffs of the different reranking paradigms under the same setting.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是描述所评估的建议如何具体化,
以文为基础的、以决策为导向的方法在同一个控制下进行
候选人重新排序设置。
我们从三个方面来审查这个问题:效力,以所得出的候选人排名的质量来衡量;效率,以观察到的在职时间为准;可伸缩性,以在候选人设定的人数从K=20K=20增加到K=200K=200时的质量和时间的变化来衡量。 这些方面加在一起,是在同一背景下不同重新排列的范式在质量-相关性上的权衡。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Framework
blocks.zh: 4 实验框架

blocks.en: We design a controlled empirical evaluation to characterize how Jev, recommendation-specific models, and Qwen-based LLM rerankers behave under the same candidate reranking setting.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一种有控制的实证评价,来描述Jev,建议特定模型,以及基于Quen的LLM重新排名者在同一个候选人重新排位的情况下的表现.

blocks.zh: 表1:亚马逊评论统计 2023年我们实验所使用的数据集. 该表在构建受控重排评价集之前,报告每个域的用户数,项目数和互动.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on three domains from the Amazon Reviews 2023 benchmark Hou et al. (2026) : Movies and TV, Video Games, and Books.
We use the 5-core leave-last-out configurations, 5core_last_out_w_his_{domain} , which retain users and items with at least five interactions and provide temporally ordered user histories together with held-out next-item interactions.
We use the predefined dataset splits without further resplitting.
blocks.zh:
我们在《2023年亚马逊评论》基准Hou等人(2026年)的三个领域进行实验: 电影与电视,电子游戏,和图书.
我们使用5个核心的请假末期配置, 5core_ last_out_w_his_domain} 它保留了至少5个交互功能的用户和项目, 并提供按时间顺序排列的用户历史以及被搁置的下一个项目交互功能 。
我们使用预定义的数据集分割,而不进行进一步的分配.

blocks.en:
For each user, the held-out item in the test split is treated as the ground-truth next interaction i u + i_{u}^{+} .
Recommendation-specific models operate on item identifiers and behavioral histories.
For language-based methods, each item is represented using available textual metadata, including the title, main category, category information, and up to the first 250 characters of the item description.
We expose the 10 most recent historical interactions to Jev and the Qwen rerankers and use the same textual representation procedure across these methods.
blocks.zh:
对于每个用户,测试拆分中被搁置的项目被作为地面真实的下一次交互i u + i_{u}^{+} .
具体建议模型在项目识别器和行为历史上运作。
对于基于语言的方法,每个项目都使用现有的文字元数据来表示,包括标题,主要类别,类别信息,最多可达项目描述的前250个字符.
我们向Jev和Quen的重新排名者揭露了最近10次历史互动,并在这些方法中采用相同的文字表述程序。

blocks.en:
We use the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol across all domains. Dataset-specific statistics, including the number of users, items, and
interactions, are reported in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们在所有领域使用同样的预处理和评价协议。 特定数据集统计数据,包括用户、项目和
互动情况见表1。

blocks.en: 4.2 Candidate Retrieval and Controlled Hard Candidate Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 征聘和控制下的候选人

blocks.en:
We adopt SASRec as the first-stage retrieval model.
SASRec is trained independently for each domain using the corresponding training split and produces a relevance score over the item catalog for each test user. Implementation details are in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们采用SASRec作为第一阶段的检索模型.
SASRec是使用相应的培训拆分为每个域独立培训的,并在项目目录上为每个测试用户产生相关分数. 执行情况详情见附录B.1。

blocks.en:
To separate reranking performance from retrieval failure, we restrict the controlled reranking evaluation to users whose ground-truth next item is retrieved within the top 200 SASRec predictions, as shown in Equation 5 .
After applying this eligibility criterion, we evaluate 954 users for Movies and TV, 1,000 users for Video Games, and 626 users for Books. For Video Games, where more than 1,000 eligible users are available, we cap the evaluation at 1,000 users for computational efficiency. All methods are evaluated on the same selected users within each domain.
We then construct candidate sets with K ∈ { 20 , 50 , 100 , 200 } K\in\{20,50,100,200\} .
For each eligible user and candidate size K K , the candidate set consists of the ground-truth next item together with K − 1 K-1 highly ranked non-target items from SASRec, as shown in Equation 6 .
The negative candidates are therefore behaviorally plausible alternatives rather than randomly sampled items.
blocks.zh:
为了将重新排序的性能与检索失败区分开来,我们把控制的重新排序评价限制在以下用户:在前200 SASRec 预测中检索到的地面-真实性下一个项目,如Equation 5所示。
在应用这一资格标准后,我们评价电影和电视的954个用户,电子游戏的1000个用户,图书的626个用户. 对于电子游戏,如果有超过1000个符合条件的用户,我们把评价上限定为1000个用户,以达到计算效率. 所有方法都在每个域内相同的选定用户上评价.
然后我们用K {20,50,100,200} 建造候选机组。
如第6项所示,对于每个合格的用户和候选人人数K K, 这套候选人包括下一个地面真相项目以及SASRec的K−1 K-1高等级非目标项目。
因此,负面候选人在行为上是可行的替代办法,而不是随机抽样。

blocks.en: Candidate membership is fixed before evaluating any reranker, and all methods operate over exactly the same candidate set for a given user and K K . Candidate order is randomized deterministically so that the input does not reveal the SASRec ranking.
blocks.zh: 在评估任何重新排行榜之前,候选人的成员资格是固定的,所有方法都对特定用户和KK的完全相同的候选人运作。 候选人顺序是随机决定的,这样输入就不会显示SASRec的排名.

blocks.en: 4.3 Compared Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 比较方法

blocks.en:
We compare Jev with recommendation-specific models and two Qwen-based LLM reranking formulations.
The evaluated LLM configurations are intended to provide representative pointwise and listwise reference points rather than an exhaustive characterization of LLM-based reranking.
blocks.zh:
我们比较Jev与建议特定模型和两个基于Quen的LLM重排配体.
评估的LLM配置旨在提供具有代表性的点和列表参考点,而不是详尽地描述基于LLM的重新排序。

blocks.en:
SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018) serves both as the first-stage retriever and as a conventional behavioral recommendation baseline. For the reranking evaluation, we preserve the original SASRec scores of the items in each controlled candidate set and rank the candidates according to these scores.
This baseline measures how much reranking changes recommendation quality relative to the behavioral model used to construct the hard candidates.
blocks.zh:
SASRec Kang和McAuley(2018年)既作为第一阶段检索器,也作为常规行为推荐基准. 对于重新排序的评价,我们保留每套受控候选人的原始SASRec评分,并根据这些评分对候选人进行排名。
这一基线衡量了相对于用于构建硬候选人的行为模型而言,重新排序对建议质量的改变程度。

blocks.en: We include DCNv2 Wang et al. (2021) as a neural ranking baseline with explicit feature interaction modeling. We represent the user’s historical interactions through pooled item embeddings and combine this representation with the embedding of each candidate item. The resulting features are processed by the cross and deep networks to obtain candidate-level relevance scores. DCNv2 is trained separately for each domain and evaluated on the same frozen candidate sets as all other methods. See Appendix B.2 for more details.
blocks.zh: 我们把DCNv2 Wang等人(2021年)列为神经排位基准,具有明显的特征相互作用模型. 我们通过集合项目嵌入来代表用户的历史互动,并将这一表述与每个候选项目的嵌入结合起来。 由此产生的特征由交叉和深层网络处理,以获得候选人级别的相关性分数。 DCNv2是针对每个领域单独培训的,与所有其他方法一样,采用同一组冷冻候选软件进行评估。 详见附录B.2。

blocks.en:
We evaluate pointwise LLM reranking using Qwen2.5 7B Instruct Qwen et al. (2025) . Each candidate is independently evaluated given the same textual user history. For candidate i i , the model predicts whether the user is likely to interact with the item next. If z 0 z_{0} and z 1 z_{1} denote the logits corresponding to the negative and positive decisions, respectively, we compute s u , i = exp ⁡ ( z 1 ) exp ⁡ ( z 0 ) + exp ⁡ ( z 1 ) s_{u,i}=\frac{\exp(z_{1})}{\exp(z_{0})+\exp(z_{1})} (12) Candidates are ranked according to s u , i s_{u,i} .
This formulation obtains a separate candidate-level relevance score for each of the K K items.
The prompt and implementation details are provided in Appendices A.1 and B.3 , respectively.

我们用Quen2.5 7B Quen 等人的指示(2025年)来评估 LLM 重新排序。 每位候选人都根据相同的文字用户历史接受独立评价。 对于候选i i,模型预测用户是否可能与下一个项目交互. 如果z 0 z_{0}和z 1 z_{1}分别表示与否定和肯定决定相对应的对数,则我们计算 su, i = exp ⁡ (z 1) exp ⁡ (z 0) + exp ⁡ (z 1) s_{u, i}=\frac\ exp (z_{1}) exp (z_{0})} (12) 候选人的排名按照s u,i s_{u,i}.
这种提法为KK各项目分别获得一个候选级别的关联分.
附录A.1和B.3分别提供了迅速和执行的细节。

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate a listwise formulation using the same Qwen2.5 7B Instruct backbone. All K K candidates are presented jointly, with each candidate assigned a unique label. We obtain the logits corresponding to the candidate labels and normalize them across the available alternatives to derive the ranking. Unlike pointwise reranking, listwise reranking requires a single joint model evaluation per user, but the input becomes increasingly long and the decision space grows as K K increases.
The prompt and implementation details are provided in Appendices A.2 and B.3 , respectively.
Neither pointwise nor listwise reranking requires free-form text generation.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们使用相同的Quen2.5 7B指令主干线对列表式配方进行评估。 所有KK候选人都是联合提交的,每个候选人都有一个独特的标签。 我们获得与候选人标签对应的对数,并将这些对数规范化,以便得出排名。 与点心重排不同,列表重排需要每个用户一个单一的联合模型评价,但输入时间越来越长,决定空间也随着K的增加而增加.

Our primary object of investigation is Jev. blocks.en: 4.5 Latency Measurement
blocks.zh: 4.5 延迟计量

blocks.en: In addition to recommendation quality, we evaluate the serving efficiency of each reranker.
blocks.zh: 除了建议质量外,我们还评估每个重新排名者的服务效率。

blocks.en: For locally executed methods, latency measures the wall-clock time from transferring preconstructed model inputs to the GPU through producing the final ranked candidate list, including model inference, score extraction, and ranking. Data loading, metadata construction, prompt construction, and item-ID preprocessing are excluded.
blocks.zh: 对于本地执行的方法,耐久度通过制作最终排名的候选名单,包括模型推论,分数提取,以及排名,从预先构建的模型输入到GPU的时钟时间进行测量. 数据加载、元数据构建、快速构建和项目ID预处理不在此列。

blocks.en:
All local latency experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU. The same hardware is used for SASRec, DCNv2, and Qwen-based rerankers to ensure consistent measurement across locally executed methods.
Jev is evaluated using observed hosted API latency and is therefore not hardware normalized with the locally executed models.
blocks.zh:
所有局部潜伏性实验均在单NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU上进行. 同样的硬件用于SASRec,DCNv2,以及基于Quen的重新排序器,以确保对本地执行方法的一致测量.
Jev是使用观测到的API潜伏性进行评价的,因此硬件没有与当地执行的模型正常化.

blocks.en: For SASRec, latency includes transferring the preconstructed inputs to the GPU, encoding the user history, scoring the K K candidate items, ranking the resulting scores, and transferring the final ranking back to the CPU. For DCNv2, latency similarly includes input transfer, candidate scoring, ranking, and result transfer. Input construction, item-ID conversion, disk I/O, and metric computation are excluded from the timed region.
blocks.zh: 对于SASRec来说,潜伏性包括将预先构建的输入转移到GPU,编码用户历史,评分KK候选项目,对产生的分数进行排名,以及将最终排名回转CPU. 对于DCNv2,耐久性同样包括输入转移,候选人得分,排名和结果转移. 输入构建,项目ID转换,磁盘I/O,以及度量计算不计入定时区域.

blocks.en: For pointwise LLM reranking, latency includes tokenization, input transfer, the batched forward passes required to score all K K candidates, logit and probability extraction, result transfer, and final candidate sorting. For listwise LLM reranking, latency includes tokenization, input transfer, the joint forward pass over the complete candidate set, candidate-label score extraction, result transfer, and final sorting. Prompt-string construction is excluded from the timed region.
blocks.zh: 对于点定的 LLM 重排, 空闲性包括象征性化, 输入转录, 批次前传通行证, 给所有 K K 考生打分, 登录和概率提取, 结果转录, 以及最后的考生排序 。 就列表而言,LLM重新排位,潜伏性包括标语化,输入转移,联合前进过完整候选人集,候选人标签分数提取,结果转移,以及最后排序. 超时速施工不包括在定时区域。

blocks.en: Jev is accessed through the TypeSafe hosted API (see Appendix B.4 ) for implementation details. We record the elapsed time of the successful request as its primary latency measure. Because hosted inference also depends on network communication, gateway routing, and provider availability, we refer to this quantity as observed serving latency rather than intrinsic model inference time. We separately record end-to-end latency including failed requests, retry waiting, and subsequent attempts. Accordingly, latency results should be interpreted under our experimental deployment setting rather than as a hardware-normalized comparison of computational complexity.

blocks.en: 4.6 Experimental Questions
blocks.zh: 4.6 实验问题

blocks.en: Our experimental framework is designed to answer four questions: • RQ1: Recommendation Effectiveness. How does Jev compare with recommendation-specific and LLM-based methods under controlled hard-candidate reranking? • RQ2: Candidate-Set Scaling. How does recommendation effectiveness change as the candidate-set size increases from K = 20 K=20 to K = 200 K=200 , and how do pointwise and listwise LLM rerankers differ in this behavior? • RQ3: Latency and Scalability. How does observed serving latency scale with candidate-set size across recommendation-specific models, pointwise and listwise LLM rerankers, and Jev? • RQ4: Quality–Latency Tradeoff and Cross-Domain Consistency. What quality–latency operating points do the different approaches provide, and are the observed patterns consistent across recommendation domains?

blocks.en: 5.1 Recommendation Effectiveness
blocks.zh: 5.1 有效性

blocks.en:
Figure 1 reports NDCG@10 as the candidate-set size increases from K = 20 K=20 to K = 200 K=200 .
Jev achieves consistently high recommendation effectiveness across all three domains.
On Movies and TV, its performance is similar to the best-performing evaluated Qwen configuration at smaller candidate sizes and remains competitive as K K increases.

在电影和电视上,其性能类似于考生规模较小的评分最佳的Quen配置,随着K的提升,其竞争力依然保持.
关于电子游戏和图书, Jev在候选人人数上普遍比其他评估方法达到更高的NDCG@10.

blocks.en:
Among the Qwen rerankers, pointwise Qwen2.5 7B Instruct generally provides the highest recommendation quality.
The listwise variant generally achieves lower effectiveness, particularly as the candidate set becomes large.
DCNv2 provides low-cost recommendation-specific reference points but typically achieves lower NDCG@10 than Jev and the better-performing pointwise Qwen configuration.
Increasing the candidate set does not affect SASRec because the candidate pool is derived from its own ranking, whereas reranking models must discriminate among an increasingly large set of plausible candidates.
blocks.zh:
在Quen重排中,指针的Quen2.5 7B Instruct一般提供最高的推荐质量.
列表的变式一般效果较低,特别是随着候选人组合变得庞大.
DCNv2提供了低成本的针对推荐的参考点,但一般能实现比Jev更低的NDCG@10,且表现较好的点wen配置.
增加候选人人数不会影响SASRec,因为候选人人数来自其自身的排名,而重新排名的模式必须区别对待越来越多的有说服力的候选人。

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that Jev is not merely an efficiency-oriented alternative: under the evaluated controlled setting, it also maintains strong ranking effectiveness relative to the compared recommendation and Qwen-based methods .
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,Jev不仅仅是一个注重效率的替代办法:在经过评价的控制环境下,它与比较建议和基于Quen的方法相比,也保持了强有力的排名效力。

blocks.en: 5.2 Effect of Candidate-Set Size
blocks.zh: 5.2 候选人数目的影响

blocks.en:
Recommendation quality decreases for the reranking methods other than SASRec as the candidate set grows, reflecting the increasing difficulty of identifying one relevant item among a larger set of strong behavioral negatives.
However, the rate of degradation differs substantially across the evaluated approaches.
blocks.zh:
随着候选人人数的增加,SASRec对重新排序方法的建议质量下降,这反映了在更大范围的强烈行为负数中确定一个相关项目越来越困难。
然而,不同评估方法的退化率差别很大。

blocks.en:
Jev exhibits comparatively gradual degradation as K K increases.
This pattern is particularly visible on Video Games and Books, where its relative performance remains strong at K = 100 K=100 and K = 200 K=200 .
Pointwise Qwen2.5 7B Instruct also degrades relatively smoothly, whereas the listwise Qwen variant shows substantially sharper declines as the candidate space expands.
blocks.zh:
随着KK的增加,Jev相对逐渐退化。
这种模式在电子游戏和图书上特别明显,其相对表现仍然强劲,在K=100K=100,K=200K=200.
尖端的Quen2.5 7B 指令还相对平稳地降解,而列表的Quen 变体则显示随着候选空间的扩大,大幅锐减.

blocks.en:
These results indicate that conclusions drawn from a single small candidate set may not generalize to larger reranking problems .
Results for MRR and Hit Rate@10 are reported in Appendix C.1 and show consistent trends.
Candidate-set size therefore represents an important experimental dimension when comparing reranking paradigms.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,从单一的小规模候选人组合中得出的结论可能无法概括为更大的重新排序问题。
附录C.1中报告了MRR和点击率@10的结果,并显示了一致的趋势。
因此,在比较重新排列的范式时,候选人设定的大小是一个重要的实验层面。

blocks.en: 5.3 Pointwise and Listwise Qwen Reranking

The pointwise and listwise Qwen formulations exhibit distinct scaling behavior.

blocks.en: These results position Jev at a distinct quality–latency operating point within the evaluated setting. blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our experiments reveal a distinct quality–latency profile for Jev under controlled recommendation reranking.
Across the evaluated domains and candidate-set sizes, Jev maintains strong ranking effectiveness while its observed serving latency grows substantially more gradually than the evaluated pointwise Qwen reranker.
The listwise Qwen variant reduces latency further, but its recommendation quality degrades more sharply as the candidate set becomes large.
Taken together, these results show that Jev occupies a different operating region from both recommendation-specific models and the evaluated LLM rerankers, motivating further study of decision-oriented formulations for recommendation tasks whose output is a structured choice among predefined alternatives.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验揭示了Jev在受控推荐下重新排序的明显质量相关性特征.
在整个受评价的领域和候选人设定的大小中,Jev保持了强有力的排名效力,而其观察到的延迟服务比受评价的Quen重新排名要慢得多。
顺理成章的Quen变体会进一步降低耐久性,但其推荐质量随着候选人组合变大而更大幅度的下降.
综合起来,这些结果表明,Jev与特定建议模型和经评估的LLM重新排序符的操作区域不同,从而促使进一步研究针对建议任务的面向决策的配方,其产出是预先确定的替代品的结构性选择。

blocks.en: 6.1 Decision-Oriented Models for Recommendation Reranking
blocks.zh: 6.1 以决定为主的建议重新排序模式

blocks.en:
Jev represents the ranking task directly as a choice among predefined alternatives.
Under our experimental setting, Jev yields both strong recommendation effectiveness and comparatively gradual growth in observed serving latency as the candidate set expands.
blocks.zh:
Jev作为预定义的替代品的选择,直接代表排名任务.
在我们的试验环境下,Jev既能产生强有力的建议效力,又能随着候选人人数的增加而相对逐步增加。

blocks.en:
However, our experiments do not expose Jev’s underlying architecture, training procedure, or serving implementation and therefore cannot establish why these differences arise.
The latency behavior may reflect properties of the model, its serving system, or both.
We consequently interpret our results as an empirical characterization of Jev under the evaluated deployment setting rather than as evidence of an inherent architectural advantage of decision-oriented models.
blocks.zh:
然而,我们的实验并没有暴露Jev的基本架构、培训程序或服务于执行,因此无法确定为何会出现这些分歧。
延迟行为可能反映模型的属性,它的服务系统,或者两者兼而有之.
因此,我们把我们的成果解释为在经过评价的部署环境中对Jev的实证描述,而不是以决策为导向模式的固有建筑优势的证据。

blocks.en: 6.2 Implications for LLM-Based Recommendation
blocks.zh: 6.2 对基于LLM的建议的影响

blocks.en:
Our results also illustrate that different LLM reranking formulations can exhibit substantially different scaling behavior.
Candidate-set size is therefore an important consideration when evaluating LLM-based rerankers, since conclusions drawn at small K K may not persist as the reranking problem becomes larger.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果还表明,不同的LLM重排配体可以表现出显著不同的缩放行为.
因此,在评价基于LLM的重新排名时,候选人设定的大小是一个重要考虑因素,因为随着重新排列的问题变得更加严重,在小KK上得出的结论可能不会持续下去。

blocks.en:
More broadly, the results suggest that general-purpose LLMs are not the only model family worth considering when textual understanding is used primarily to support a structured ranking decision.
For applications in which the ranking itself is the primary output, decision-oriented models such as Jev may provide a useful alternative operating point.
blocks.zh:
更广义地说,这些结果表明,一般用途的有限责任方案并非唯一值得考虑的模式家庭,因为文本理解主要用于支持结构化的排序决定。
对于排名本身为主要产出的应用程序,Jev等面向决策的模型可能提供一个有用的替代操作点.

blocks.en: 6.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.3 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that define the scope of the conclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,确定了结论的范围。

blocks.en:
First, we evaluate only one decision-oriented model.
Jev provides an opportunity to study this modeling paradigm, but the observed results should not be generalized to decision-oriented models as a whole.
Future work should examine whether similar quality–latency patterns emerge as additional models become available.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们只评价一个注重决策的模式。
Jev为研究这一模型范式提供了机会,但观测到的结果不应被概括为整个面向决策的模式.
今后的工作应审查是否随着其他模式的出现而出现类似的质量-相关性模式。

blocks.en:
Second, our LLM evaluation is limited to Qwen2.5 7B Instruct.
These configurations provide representative pointwise and listwise reranking baselines, but they do not characterize the maximum recommendation quality achievable by substantially larger or proprietary LLMs.
Larger models may achieve stronger ranking effectiveness, potentially with different serving costs.
Accordingly, our conclusions concern the evaluated Qwen configurations rather than LLM-based reranking as a whole.
Similarly, we include representative sequential recommendation, and neural ranking approaches, but do not attempt to reproduce the full range of proprietary architectures and serving systems used in large-scale industrial recommender systems.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们的LLM评价仅限于Quen2.5 7B指令.
这些配置提供了具有代表性的点位和列表的重新排序基线,但它们并没有描述通过大幅扩大或专有的有限责任公司可达到的最大推荐质量。
较大的模型可以实现更强的排位有效性,可能具有不同的服务成本.
因此,我们的结论涉及经过评估的Quen配置,而不是基于LLM的整体重新排序。
同样,我们包括具有代表性的顺序建议和神经排列方法,但不试图复制大规模工业推荐系统所使用的各种专有结构和服务系统。

blocks.en:
Third, the latency comparison is not hardware normalized.
SASRec, DCNv2, and Qwen are evaluated locally on a single GPU, whereas Jev is accessed through a hosted API whose underlying hardware, batching strategy, and serving infrastructure are not exposed to us.
Jev latency therefore includes network communication and remote-serving overhead.
We interpret the reported values as observed serving latency under our experimental conditions rather than intrinsic computational cost.
blocks.zh:
第三,延迟比较没有使硬件正常化。
SASRec、DCNv2和Quen通过一个单一的GPU在当地进行评估,而Jev则通过一个托管的API访问,其基本的硬件、批量策略和服务基础设施不向我们暴露。
因此,Jev latency包括网络通信和远程服务间接费用。
我们把所报告的数值解释为试验条件下观察到的暂时性,而不是内在计算成本。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Overall, our study provides an initial empirical characterization of Jev for controlled recommendation reranking and highlights the distinct scaling behaviors of recommendation-specific, pointwise and listwise LLM-based, and decision-oriented approaches. Within the evaluated setting, Jev occupies a distinct quality–latency operating regime, particularly as the candidate set grows. These findings do not establish decision-oriented models as universally preferable to general-purpose LLMs, but they suggest that structured decision formulations deserve further consideration for recommendation tasks whose primary output is a ranking over predefined alternatives. Future work should extend this investigation to larger and more diverse LLMs, additional decision-oriented models, alternative retrieval pipelines, and real-world recommendation environments.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,我们的研究为Jev的受控建议重新排位提供了初步的经验性特征,并突出了针对具体建议、按指针和按列表列出的基于LLM和以决策为导向的方法的不同比例化行为。 在经过评价的环境下,Jev拥有一种独特的质量-相关性操作制度,特别是随着候选人人数的增长。 这些结论并未确立与一般用途有限责任方案相比普遍可取的面向决定的模式,但它们表明,结构化的决策案文值得进一步审议,以便完成建议任务,其主要产出是优先于预先确定的替代办法。 今后的工作应当将这一调查扩大到更大、更多样化的有限责任公司、更多的面向决策的模式、替代检索管道和现实世界的建议环境。

blocks.en: Appendix A Prompt and Input Templates
blocks.zh: 提示和输入模板

blocks.en: Across the language-based methods, the user history is represented using the same textual descriptions of the most recent interactions. Candidate item descriptions are constructed using the same metadata preprocessing procedure described in Section 4.1 . Candidate order is deterministically randomized before inference and is held fixed across methods for each user and candidate-set size.

blocks.en: A.3 Jev Input Formulation
blocks.zh: A.3 Jev 输入法

blocks.en: Jev uses a structured decision interface rather than a conventional system–user prompt format. For each user, the recent interaction history is supplied as the decision state, and candidate items are represented as the available alternatives in a choice -type question. The instruction is as follows:
blocks.zh: Jev使用结构化的决策接口,而不是常规系统-用户即时格式。 对于每个用户来说,最近的交互历史作为决定状态提供,在选择类型问题中,候选项目作为可用的替代品提供。 指示如下:

blocks.en: Based on the user’s interaction history, which candidate item is the user most likely to interact with next?
blocks.zh: 根据用户的交互历史,哪个候选项目最有可能与下一个交互?

blocks.zh: 根据用户的交互历史,哪个候选项目最有可能与下一个交互?

blocks.en: Jev returns a probability for each candidate alternative under the next_item question. We directly use these probabilities as candidate ranking scores.
blocks.zh: Jev 返回下一个项目问题下每个候选选项的概率 。 我们直接使用这些概率作为候选人的排名分数.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附 录 B 细节

blocks.en: This section provides additional implementation details for the evaluated methods. Unless otherwise stated, models are trained separately for each recommendation domain. All locally executed inference experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU. Latency is measured according to the protocol described in Section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 本节提供了所评价方法的其他实施细节。 除非另有说明,每个建议领域对模型分别进行培训。 所有本地执行的推论实验都是在一个单NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU上进行的. 第4.5节所述的协议衡量延迟。

blocks.en: B.1 SASRec
blocks.zh: B.1 SASRec

blocks.en: We implement SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018) as both the first-stage retrieval model and a recommendation-specific baseline. Item identifiers are mapped to learned embeddings, and each user’s historical interactions are truncated to a maximum sequence length of 50.
blocks.zh: 我们把SASRec Kang和McAuley(2018年)作为第一阶段检索模式和具体建议的基准。 物品标识符被映射到学习的嵌入,每个用户的历史互动被缩短到最大序列长度50.

blocks.en: The SASRec model uses an embedding dimension of 64, two self-attention blocks, two attention heads, and a dropout rate of 0.2. Training uses a batch size of 256 with 64 sampled negative items per positive interaction. The model is trained separately for each domain using the corresponding training split. The resulting checkpoint is used both to construct the controlled hard candidate sets and to score candidates in the SASRec baseline.
blocks.zh: SASRec模型采用64的嵌入维度,两个自注块,两个注意力头,辍学率为0.2. 培训采用256个批量规模,每个正相互作用有64个抽样的负项。 该模型采用相应的培训分法为每个领域单独培训。 由此产生的检查站既用于建造受控制的硬候选人套,也用于在SASRec基线中给候选人打分。

blocks.en: During inference, the preconstructed user sequence and candidate tensors are transferred to the GPU, after which SASRec encodes the user history, scores all K K candidates, and ranks them according to their predicted relevance. The final ranking is transferred back to the CPU before timing ends. Input construction, item-ID conversion, disk I/O, and metric computation are excluded from the timed region.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,预先构建的用户序列和候选的对数器被转移至GPU,之后SASRec编码了用户历史,给所有KK候选人打分,并根据其预测的相关性进行排名. 最终排名在计时结束前转回CPU. 输入构建,项目ID转换,磁盘I/O,以及度量计算不计入定时区域.

blocks.en: B.2 DCNv2
blocks.zh: B.2 多CNv2

blocks.en: We implement DCNv2 Wang et al. (2021) as an ID-based neural ranking baseline. Each item is represented using a 64-dimensional learned embedding. The user’s historical representation is obtained by pooling the embeddings of the non-padding items in the interaction history and is combined with each candidate-item embedding for ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们执行DCNv2 Wang等人(2021年)作为基于ID的神经排列基线. 每个项目都使用64维的学习嵌入来表示. 用户的历史代表性是通过将非打字项目嵌入到互动历史中来获得的,并与每个候选项目嵌入进行排名相结合.

blocks.en: The ranking network contains a three-layer DCNv2 cross network together with a parallel deep network with hidden dimensions 256 and 128. We use a dropout rate of 0.2 in the deep component. The outputs of the cross and deep components are combined to produce a scalar relevance score for each candidate.
blocks.zh: 排名网络包含一个三层的DCNv2交叉网络,以及一个具有隐藏维度256和128的平行深层网络. 我们在深层部分使用0.2的辍学率。 将交叉部分和深层部分的产出合并,为每个候选人产生一个标尺相关性分数。

blocks.en:
To maintain consistency with SASRec, DCNv2 uses the same domain-specific training split, item vocabulary construction, and negative-sampling procedure. Each positive training instance is paired with 64 sampled negatives. DCNv2 is trained separately for each domain and evaluated on the same frozen candidate sets as all other methods.
DCNv2 uses the same 10 most recent user interactions exposed to the language-based rerankers for reranking evaluation.
blocks.zh:
为了保持与SASRec的一致性,DCNv2采用了相同的域特异性训练分解,项目词汇构建,以及负采样程序. 每一次正面培训都配有64个抽样底片。 DCNv2是针对每个领域单独培训的,与所有其他方法一样,采用同一组冷冻候选软件进行评估。
DCNv2采用了相同的10个最近接触语言重排器的用户交互,进行重排评价.

blocks.en: During inference, the preconstructed history and candidate tensors are transferred to the GPU, all K K candidates are scored in parallel, and the resulting scores are sorted to produce the final ranking. The ranking is transferred back to the CPU before timing ends. Input construction, item-ID conversion, disk I/O, and metric computation are excluded from the timed region.
blocks.zh: 推算期间,将预构历史和候选的辩数转至GPU,K所有考生均平行得分,并按产生的分数进行排序以产生最终排名. 排名在计时结束前转回CPU. 输入构建,项目ID转换,磁盘I/O,以及度量计算不计入定时区域.

blocks.en: Both SASRec and DCNv2 are optimized using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and weight decay of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , for a maximum of 20 epochs. We select the SASRec checkpoint with the highest validation NDCG@10 and the DCNv2 checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. For both models, training stops early if the corresponding validation criterion does not improve for three consecutive epochs.
blocks.zh: SASRec和DCNv2都使用亚当W进行优化,学习速度为10−3 10−3}体重衰减为10−5 10−5},最长为20个纪元. 我们选择SASRec检查点进行最高验证NDCG@10,DCNv2检查点进行最低验证损失. 对两种模型来说,如果相应的验证标准连续三个纪元都没有改善,则训练会提前停止.

blocks.en: B.3 Qwen Rerankers
blocks.zh: B.3 Quen 调整键

blocks.en: We evaluate Qwen2.5 7B Instruct Qwen et al. (2025) in both pointwise and listwise reranking configurations. The model is executed locally on a single NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU using bfloat16 precision. The same textual representation of the user’s 10 most recent interactions and the same candidate metadata are used.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Qune2.5 7B Quen 等人(2025年)在指针和列表中重排配置. 该模型使用bfloat16精度在单NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB GPU上局部执行. 对用户最近的10个互动和同样的候选元数据采用了相同的文字表述。

blocks.en:
For pointwise reranking, each candidate is paired with the user history using the prompt in Appendix A.1 . Rather than generating a free-form response, we extract the next-token logits associated with the 0 and 1 decision tokens and normalize them using a two-way softmax. The probability assigned to 1 is used as the candidate relevance score.
Candidate prompts are processed with a batch size of 16, and the final ranking is obtained by sorting candidates according to these scores. In preliminary experiments on a smaller evaluation subset, we varied the pointwise batch size and observed negligible differences in both ranking effectiveness and per-user latency; we therefore use a batch size of 16 throughout the main experiments.
blocks.zh:
对于点位重排,每个候选人使用附录A.1中的提示与用户历史对齐。 与其产生自由式的响应,不如提取与0和1决定符号相关的下一对对数,并使用双向软码使其正常化. 分配给1的概率作为候选相关分数.
候选人告示的批次大小为16个,最后的排名是根据这些分数对候选人进行排序而获得的. 在对一个较小的评价子集的初步实验中,我们按点划分的批量大小不同,观察到在排位有效性和每个用户的延迟度上可以忽略不计的差别;因此,我们在整个主要实验中采用16个批量大小。

blocks.en: For listwise reranking, all K K candidates are presented jointly using the prompt in Appendix A.2 . Each candidate is assigned a unique label corresponding to a single tokenizer token. We extract the next-token logits associated with these candidate labels and normalize them across the candidate set to obtain ranking scores. The complete candidate set is processed in a single model forward pass.
blocks.zh: 为了重新排列名单,所有K K候选人都使用附录A.2中的提示方式联合提出。 每个候选人被分配到一个独特的标签,对应一个单一的标语符号. 我们提取与这些候选人标签有关的下一批登录数据,并将这些登录数据在候选人的组合中正常化,以获得排名分数。 完整的候选人名单以单一模式前方通行证处理。

blocks.en: For both formulations, latency includes tokenization, transfer of tokenized inputs to the GPU, model inference, logit and probability extraction, transfer of the resulting scores to the CPU, and final candidate sorting. Prompt-string construction is excluded from the timed region. No sampling-based decoding parameters such as temperature or top- p p are used because ranking scores are obtained directly from model logits.
blocks.zh: 对于这两种配方,耐用性包括标注化,向GPU转移标注式输入,模型推论,登录和概率提取,向CPU转移所产生的分数,以及最后的候选者排序. 超时速施工不包括在定时区域。 没有使用基于采样的解码参数,例如温度或顶级-p,因为排名分数直接来自模型日志.

blocks.en: Before running the final experiments, we verify that every pointwise and listwise input remains within the corresponding model context window, including all cases with K = 200 K=200 ; no evaluated prompt requires truncation.
blocks.zh: 在进行最后的实验之前,我们核实每一个点和列表输入都留在相应的模型上下文窗口内,包括K = 200 K = 200的所有案例;没有评估的快速需要切换.

blocks.en: B.4 Jev
blocks.zh: B.4 贾夫

blocks.en: Jev is accessed through TypeSafe AI’s hosted API using jev-latest as of September 30, 2026. For each user, the textual representation of the 10 most recent interactions is supplied as the decision state, while the K K candidate items are represented as alternatives in a choice -type question. The exact request structure is provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: Jev从2026年9月30日起使用Jev-latest通过TypeSafe AI托管的API访问. 对于每个用户,10个最新互动的文字表述作为决定状态提供,而K K候选项目则作为选择类型问题的替代品提供。 确切的要求结构见附录A.3。

blocks.en: Jev returns a probability for each candidate alternative, which is used directly as its reranking score without additional calibration or post-processing. Candidate order is deterministically randomized before submission and is identical to that used for the corresponding evaluation cases.
blocks.zh: Jev返回每个候选选项的概率,该概率直接用作其重新排序的分数,而无需额外的校准或后处理. 候选人的顺序在提交前按随机顺序确定,与相应的评价案件相同。

blocks.en: Because Jev is accessed through a hosted service, its underlying hardware, numerical precision, batching strategy, and serving configuration are not available to us. We therefore report observed serving latency rather than intrinsic model inference time, following the protocol described in Section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 由于Jev是通过主机服务访问的,因此其基础硬件,数字精度,批量策略,以及服务配置,我们无法使用. 因此,我们报告注意到,根据第4.5节所述议定书,服务于暂时性,而不是固有的模型推断时间。

blocks.zh: C.1 MRR和点击率@10

blocks.en: To assess whether the observed trends depend on the choice of ranking metric, we additionally evaluate all methods using MRR and Hit Rate. The corresponding results are reported in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估所观察到的趋势是否取决于对排名的衡量标准的选择,我们进一步评估了所有使用MRR和点击率的方法。 相应结果见表2。

blocks.en:
Overall, the results are consistent with those based on NDCG@10 in the main text. In particular, the relative behavior of the evaluated reranking methods changes as the candidate set grows, indicating that conclusions obtained from small candidate sets do not necessarily generalize to larger reranking settings. These results further suggest that the main findings are not specific to NDCG@10, but remain qualitatively similar under alternative ranking metrics.
For SASRec, Hit Rate@10 remains unchanged across candidate-set sizes because the controlled candidate sets are constructed from its own ranking.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,结果与正文中基于NDCG@10的结果一致. 特别是,被评价的重新排序方法的相对行为随着候选人组合的增长而变化,表明从小候选人组合获得的结论并不一定概括到更大的重新排序设置. 这些结果进一步表明,主要结论并不针对NDCG@10,但在备选排名衡量标准下在质量上仍然相似。
就SASRec而言,在候选人设定的大小中,Hit rate@10保持不变,因为受控候选人集是按自己的排名构建的。

blocks.en: C.2 Latency Distribution Statistics
blocks.zh: C.2 延迟分布统计

blocks.en: To complement the average observed latency reported in the main text, we further examine the distribution of per-user latency. For each method, candidate-set size, and domain, Table 3 reports the median latency together with the 25th and 75th percentiles in milliseconds. The distributional results are consistent with the trends observed in Figure 2 : recommendation-specific models operate at substantially lower latency than Jev and the Qwen rerankers, while Jev exhibits substantially lower latency than pointwise Qwen as the candidate set grows.
blocks.zh: 为了补充正文中报告的观察到的平均延迟,我们进一步审查了每个用户延迟的分布。 对于每种方法,候选设置大小,以及域,表3以毫秒计报告中位纬度以及第25和第75百分位数。 分配结果与图2所示的趋势一致:具体建议模型的延迟程度大大低于Jev和Quen的调整等级,而随着候选人人数的增加,Jev的延迟程度大大低于Quen。
